title: Talking About the Future: going to, Present Continuous and will
explanation: Use going to for plans you have already decided (I'm going to visit my parents). Use the present continuous for fixed arrangements (I'm meeting Sara at six). Use will for a decision you make now (I'll answer it), for offers and for opinions about the future (I think it will be sunny).
explanationPersian: از going to برای برنامه‌ای که قبلاً تصمیمش را گرفته‌ای استفاده کن (I'm going to visit my parents). از حال استمراری برای قرارهای مشخص (I'm meeting Sara at six). از will برای تصمیم لحظه‌ای (I'll answer it)، پیشنهاد و نظر دربارهٔ آینده (I think it will be sunny).

examples.english: I'm going to visit my parents on Sunday.
examples.persian: یکشنبه می‌خواهم به پدر و مادرم سر بزنم.

examples.english: We're meeting at six outside the station.
examples.persian: ساعت شش جلوی ایستگاه همدیگر را می‌بینیم.

examples.english: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
examples.persian: تلفن زنگ می‌زند. من جواب می‌دهم.

examples.english: I think it will rain tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
exercises.explanation: going to: a prediction from what we see now
exercises.explanationPersian: going to: پیش‌بینی بر اساس چیزی که الان می‌بینیم.

exercises.prompt: The phone is ringing. — "I ___ answer it."
exercises.explanationPersian: will: تصمیمی که همین حالا می‌گیریم.

acceptedAnswers: to
will
'll
exercises.explanation: will + base verb for opinions about the future
exercises.explanationPersian: will + فعل ساده برای نظر دربارهٔ آینده

acceptedAnswers: I will help you.
I'll help you.

exercises.incorrectSentence: Tomorrow I go to the doctor at ten. (a plan)
acceptedAnswers: Tomorrow I'm going to the doctor at ten.
Tomorrow I'm going to go to the doctor at ten.
Tomorrow I am going to the doctor at ten.
exercises.explanation: For arrangements use the present continuous or going to.
exercises.explanationPersian: برای قرار از حال استمراری یا going to استفاده کن.

acceptedAnswers: I'm meeting my friend tomorrow.
I am meeting my friend tomorrow.
I'm going to meet my friend tomorrow.
I am going to meet my friend tomorrow.
Tomorrow I'm meeting my friend.
I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

exercises.source: من فردا برایت یک چای درست می‌کنم.
acceptedAnswers: I'll make you a tea tomorrow.
I'll make you tea tomorrow.
I will make you a tea tomorrow.
I will make you tea tomorrow.
I'll make a tea for you tomorrow.
I'll make tea for you tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: will = an offer or a promise

exercises.prompt: Say it with "going to": "I plan to study tonight."
acceptedAnswers: I'm going to study tonight.
I am going to study tonight.
